name: Supplier invoice to draft bill

parameters.content:
## Supplier invoice → draft bill
PDF text → AI extraction to a fixed schema → checks → draft bill or exception queue.

**Guards:** GST must be 15% (0 for overseas suppliers) · subtotal + GST = total · lines add up · known supplier · no duplicate invoice number · PO amount within 5% · every amount must appear in the PDF text.

**AI off:** generic label regexes extract the fields.
